label: D2 late in the episode (low value), stronger after an unrewarded previous trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never at D1 or GO), and almost entirely in the last ~20 trials of the 100-trial episode: 99% of mass is at ep_trial>=50, 71% at trials 90-99, and the active rate rises steadily with ep_trial. Matches the value head: 72% of mass is in the lowest value bin (<5.22) and there is none above 7.73. The effect is stronger after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward=0 holds 85% of mass), so it shows up from about trial 80 after no reward and in every case near the very end. The largest activations are at the final D2s of the episode. Reached state S2 gets a mild boost. It does not depend on the current transition (common/rare) or the action. It reads as a graded end-of-episode / low-expected-value signal, not a clean discrete event. A hard ep_trial threshold misses the graded onset, which caps F1 near 0.72 (dev P 0.66, R 0.79, mass recall 0.89). Thresholding value alone gives a lower F1 (0.60). Uses only observed variables: elapsed time, which the agent can track, and the previous reward.
